""name"": ""How many questions are on the AP CSP practice exams?"",

""text"": ""Each of the three full AP CSP practice exams contains 70 multiple-choice questions with 4 answer choices (A-D), matching the format of the real AP Computer Science Principles exam. The suggested time is 120 minutes per exam, just like the actual digital exam.""
""name"": ""Which Big Ideas are most important for the AP CSP exam?"",

""text"": ""Big Idea 3 (Algorithms and Programming) carries the most weight at 30-35% of the AP CSP exam, followed by Big Idea 5 (Impact of Computing) at 21-26% and Big Idea 2 (Data) at 17-22%. Together these three Big Ideas account for the majority of MCQ questions. Practicing by Big Idea helps you identify exactly where your gaps are before taking a full 70-question exam.""
""name"": ""What is the passing score for the AP CSP exam?"",

""text"": ""A score of 3 or higher is considered passing for AP credit at most colleges. A score of 4 or 5 is needed for credit at more selective institutions. On these practice exams, aim for 70% or higher to indicate readiness for a 4 or 5 on the real exam.""
""name"": ""How many practice exams does APCSExamPrep have for AP CSP?"",
